description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling 'ThingDefinitionDeleted' events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy class and implements logic to remove a definition from a 'ThingBuilder' when such an event occurs.

classes.name: ThingDefinitionDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a specific event handling strategy for 'ThingDefinitionDeleted' events, extending the abstract base class for thing event strategies.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle the 'ThingDefinitionDeleted' event by removing the definition from the 'ThingBuilder' instance.
